What kind of interface the row is, which also fixes how Physical System and Signal Owner relate. Measurement: state acquired by a controller from sensing hardware, including crew levers, selectors and pushbuttons; Physical to Owner. Command: hardwired drive of an effector or safety device; Owner to Physical; Analog or Discrete. Request: setpoint, enable or mode asked of another controller over a data bus; Owner to Physical; Digital. Computed: value derived by its owner, Physical empty. Power: electrical supply, Owner is the source and Physical the load. See the Signal Role philosophy section in README.
